description: This file defines an interface named InvocationStrategyInterface within the Slim Framework, specifying a contract for invoking route callables with a dedicated __invoke method.

classes.name: InvocationStrategyInterface
classes.description: An interface defining a contract for invoking route callables in the Slim Framework, requiring the implementation of the __invoke method.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes a route callable using a specific strategy, accepting a callable, request, response, and route arguments, and returning a ResponseInterface.
